- **Crazy_top**: Reference shows abnormal leaf proliferation at plant tops — not visible here

The test image closely matches Maize_chlorotic_dwarf_virus with its characteristic stunted plant growth and chlorotic (pale green/light) coloring compared to the taller healthy neighbors.
